decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The replacement of the existing pebble style render of the front of the house to a smooth render finish, would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the street scene and would satisfactorily maintain the appearance and character of the conservation area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Replacement of the "Pebble " style render on the front of the house toa smooth style.
